version.why: head of the default branch, re-checked on 2026-09-27; the README installs from source with scripts/setup.sh, and the one release (v1.0.0, 50912fd) sits on a separate root commit that main does not contain

caps.notes: 512 client slots fixed at compile time (include/client.h MAX_CLIENTS); an audio and a waterfall socket take one each, so about 256 browser listeners. maxusers (100 in the shipped config, 2000 in matched) is reported but never enforced. No per-address limit (HTTP_MAX_CONN_PER_IP 0). The waterfall runs at 1/4 rate above slowdownusers sockets and 1/8 above slowdownusers2 (20 and 30 as shipped, 2000 in matched), counting audio and waterfall sockets alike, so about 10 and 15 browser listeners
